moved.sentence: Trace each anticipated change request to a stakeholder — if two stakeholders can drive changes to the same module independently, the module carries two responsibilities and should split

judged.note: The rule keeps at SHOULD tracing each change request to a stakeholder and splitting a module two stakeholders can drive independently, with the two-responsibilities reason.

moved.sentence: Keep code that changes together, together; separate code that changes for different reasons even if it looks similar today

judged.note: The rule keeps at SHOULD keeping code that changes together together and separating code that changes for different reasons even if it looks similar today.

moved.sentence: Treat unexpected merge conflicts between unrelated features as a signal that a module is absorbing responsibilities for more than one actor

judged.note: The rule keeps at SHOULD treating unexpected merge conflicts between unrelated features as a signal of a module serving more than one actor.

moved.sentence: A long function or wide class is usually a sign that multiple actors share it — prefer narrow units each answerable to one actor

judged.note: The rule keeps that a long function or wide class usually signals multiple actors and preferring narrow single-actor units at SHOULD.
